name: Ghost Clean
tagline: ghost-editor's clean: Montserrat 800 mixed-case captions, the active word yellow, snap zooms, rare cards, no music.

motion.direction: ghost-editor `clean` — "Hormozi-restrained". Captions Montserrat 800 mixed case, groups ≤ 3 words, new group on punctuation or a 0.6 s pause, shown 0.05 s early, held 0.3 s after, the active word yellow `gold` (set on word start, no pulse); the placer keeps captions below the chin, never over eyes or mouth. Snap zooms: instant cuts to 1.06 (origin at the face) on beats; cards are rare — a `counter` or `chips` in the band under the chin, a `strikeLine` on the wrong claim, at most one card and one reaction at a time. Beats default 2.5 s. Nothing on screen the speaker did not say; no music; 6–12 subtle hits a minute.
